title: The Love Hypothesis
plot_overview: A biology PhD candidate who has little interest in romance starts a fake relationship with a famously intimidating professor after an impulsive kiss. As they navigate academic pressures and personal challenges, their carefully managed arrangement begins to complicate their ideas about love.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like light, chemistry-driven campus romances such as Set It Up; Not for you if you want a faithful book adaptation or a slow, deeply developed love story.
review_summary: Pros: charming romantic premise; appealing chemistry; engaging science setting | Cons: familiar story beats; rushed relationship development; adaptation changes
